title.en: An Act Creating Barrio Gordon Heights in the City of Olongapo.
title.orig: An Act Creating Barrio Gordon Heights in the City of Olongapo.

text.en: The whole area of Purok 7 in the Barrio of Santa Rita, City of Olongapo, is hereby separated from said barrio and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said city, to be known as Barrio Gordon Heights. Barrio Gordon Heights shall be bounded on the North by Barrio Barretto, on the east by watershed area, on the south by Mabayuan River and on the west by Mabayuan and Santa Rita boundaries.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
